description: This file declares functions for optimizing and manipulating computational graphs in PyTorch's JIT tensor expression module, including operations like optimizing 'cat' nodes, annotating input shapes, removing unused arguments, trimming graphs, and making shapes symbolic.

methods.name: OptimizeCat
methods.description: Optimizes 'aten::cat' operations within a graph by moving user operations into its inputs to reduce intermediate buffer allocations.

methods.name: annotateInputShapes
methods.description: Annotates input shapes in a graph with symbolic dimensions based on example inputs.

methods.name: removeUnusedSelfArgument
methods.description: Removes unused 'self' arguments from a graph.

methods.name: removeGraphOutput
methods.description: Removes a specified output from a graph.

methods.name: replaceListOutputWithTuple
methods.description: Replaces list outputs in a graph with tuple outputs.

methods.name: trimGraph
methods.description: Performs iterative trimming of a graph to simplify or minimize it for debugging.

methods.name: makeShapesSymbolic
methods.description: Replaces specific dimension sizes in a graph with symbolic shape variables.

methods.name: isGraphCompilable
methods.description: Checks if a graph can be converted to Tensor Expression IR.

methods.name: fixupMissingShapeInfo
methods.description: Fills in missing tensor type information in a graph, such as dtype, device, and shape.
